scope: checkpoint self-identification, preflight traceability, and execution-record reproducibility only

discovery.issue: A clean-room postcheck reproduced the A2 checkpoint headline result of zero cold-start passes in global indices [0,200), but the A2 checkpoint's embedded cold preflight classifications at global indices 3248 and 3257 are inconsistent with a fresh execution of the current committed Stage B decoder and equations. The current committed decoder maps index 3248 to radiator_ua_nominal_w_per_k=400 and index 3257 to radiator_ua_nominal_w_per_k=1100 for the same structural case and other control values. The clean-room postcheck classified 3248 as FAIL and 3257 as PASS, whereas the A2 checkpoint recorded the opposite. This indicates that checkpoint self-identification was insufficient to prove which runtime module set generated the embedded preflight labels.
discovery.affected_claim: A2 checkpoint promotion as fully self-verifying authoritative Stage B evidence
discovery.headline_range_result_reproduced: zero cold-start passes for global indices [0,200)
discovery.interpretation: This is an execution-record provenance defect. It is not evidence for or against M2 physics and does not authorize changing any physical model, grid, threshold, or evidence role.

historical_disposition.reason: The embedded preflight classifications cannot be tied unambiguously to the current committed decoder by the checkpoint payload itself.

required_checkpoint_self_identification.runtime_source_hash_policy: Compute SHA-256 from the actual imported/loaded source files in the executing environment immediately before preflight and include the digests in every checkpoint payload.
required_checkpoint_self_identification.preflight_parameter_snapshot_policy: Every physical preflight row must include the complete StageBCase.to_dict() snapshot for the indexed case.

authoritative_execution_contract.global_index_ordering: Cartesian product in A2 order with gamma varying fastest inside the control grid and global_index = structural_index * 243 + control_index.
authoritative_execution_contract.per_configuration_solver: one independent scipy.solve_ivp RK45 integration of the four-state M2 system
authoritative_execution_contract.engine_heat_profile: compute direct_fuel_energy_rate_w * wall_heat_fraction at retained source samples, then linearly interpolate the resulting engine-heat profile
authoritative_execution_contract.compiled_rhs_role: arithmetic acceleration only; SciPy solve_ivp remains the integrator and each physical configuration retains its own adaptive controller
